metadata.change_reason: Acceptance criteria and test specification quality standard, enforcing 100% product invariant coverage and >= 30% defensive negative scenarios

spec.name: Acceptance Criteria & Test Specification Quality Standard

rules.statement: Acceptance test cases must achieve 100% verification coverage over product invariants
Defensive/negative test scenarios must account for at least 30% of total acceptance test cases
Every acceptance scenario must explicitly trace to user stories and invariants
Acceptance criteria and DoD gates strictly prohibit unresolved placeholders such as TBD or TODO
